description.value: Cloudera provides the Cloudera Data Platform, a collection of products related to cloud services and data processing; it is an American data lake software company.
Cloudera, Inc. is a U.S. data lake software company that sells cloud data platform software for data analysis and machine learning.
Cloudera is the only hybrid data and AI platform company that brings AI to data anywhere.
Sells a hybrid data and AI platform that brings AI to data 'anywhere', across clouds, data centers and the edge.
Data management and analytics software company founded in 2008.

product_description.value: Cloudera Anywhere Cloud is the modular hybrid data and AI platform engineered for the Sovereign AI era.

Anywhere Cloud (core platform); Enterprise AI (Cloudera AI, AI Inference, AI Studios, AI Assistants, AI Workbench); Data in Motion (Data Flow, Streaming, Edge Management); Open Data Lakehouse (Apache Iceberg based); Unified Data Fabric (governance, catalog, lineage, observability).
Cloudera Data Platform, a set of cloud and data-processing tools marketed as a data lakehouse; supports Apache Iceberg (2022).
Cloudera Data Platform, a collection of products related to cloud services and data processing.
Hybrid data platform built on Apache Hadoop and other open-source tools, covering data engineering, warehousing, machine learning, analytics, security and governance.

business_model_description.value: Early model earned revenue by selling support and consulting services around a free Hadoop-based product; some services are private cloud subscriptions.

Started with a free Hadoop-based product earning revenue from support and consulting, then sold a commercial Hadoop distribution (2009); some services run on Microsoft Azure or AWS and others are private cloud subscriptions.
Revenue comes mainly from software subscriptions, with professional services, support and training on top; sells primarily through a direct sales force.

customer_description.value: Logos shown include IQVIA, the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, Regions Bank, Intel, LG U+, Tsingtao, Continental, LY Corp, Dell Technologies, SAIC Volkswagen, GEODIS, PricewaterhouseCoopers, Mastercard and British Telecom; featured case studies include Regions Bank, Vodafone Idea, Telkomsel, Bank of Montreal and Healthesystems.
Other logos shown include IQVIA, the US CDC, Intel, Dell Technologies, PwC, Mastercard and BT.
Large enterprises and public-sector organizations in finance, healthcare, telecommunications, retail and government; one source puts the customer count at about 1,900.
